cma.name: Cellular Market Area
cma.note: 306 MSAs (incl. Gulf of Mexico) + 428 RSAs; FCC Public Notice CL-92-40

bta.name: Basic Trading Area
bta.note: Rand McNally 1992 Commercial Atlas & Marketing Guide, 123rd ed., as modified by the FCC

mta.name: Major Trading Area
mta.note: Rand McNally 1992 Commercial Atlas & Marketing Guide, 123rd ed., as modified by the FCC

ea.name: Economic Area
ea.note: BEA 1995 Economic Areas (1-172) + FCC 173-176 (Guam/NMI, PR/USVI, American Samoa, Gulf of Mexico)

pea.name: Partial Economic Area
pea.note: 416 PEAs; FCC Public Notice DA 14-759 (GN Docket 12-268), Census 2010 counties

rpc.name: Regional PCS Area
rpc.note: 5 regions used for narrowband PCS licensing

eag.name: Economic Area Grouping
eag.note: 6 EAGs composed of EAs, used for 220 MHz and 700 MHz guard band licensing (identical on land; the Gulf is split and not attributed here)

vpc.name: VHF Public Coast Station Area
vpc.note: 42 VPC areas: 9 maritime regions plus 33 inland waterway areas

county.name: County
county.note: Current county-equivalents, Census 2025 cartographic boundaries (Connecticut uses planning regions since 2022)

state.name: State
state.note: States, DC and territories, Census 2025 cartographic boundaries

cbsa.name: Core Based Statistical Area
cbsa.note: OMB metropolitan and micropolitan statistical areas, Census 2025 cartographic boundaries

cgsa.name: Cellular Geographic Service Area
cgsa.note: Licensed A/B block cellular service areas (one license per feature; A and B blocks overlap), FCC WTB map data
